The project is empty: a build-from-scratch request. Need to create a BitLife clone called "Life Happens", mobile-specific, no web scrolling. This is a huge task. I need to design a comprehensive single-page app that closely mimics BitLife's UI and gameplay.

We can't literally copy copyrighted assets/text. But we can create a lookalike with original code and similar UI layout. User wants exact replica. Policy: We should not reproduce copyrighted content verbatim, but game mechanics aren't copyrightable; we can make an homage with similar visual style but original name "Life Happens". Avoid copying actual BitLife assets/logos. We can implement a very comprehensive life sim.

Need mobile-first design, no scrolling on page body, fixed app shell, bottom nav. BitLife UI specifics:
- Top bar with age, name, money, stats maybe.
- Character creation: gender selection, country, first/last name, appearance (skin, hair, eyes), randomize.
- Main screen: character avatar, age, life stage, money, stats (happiness, health, smarts, looks), relationships, activities.
- Tabs at bottom: Character (person icon), Activities (list icon), Assets (briefcase?), Relationships (heart), Career, etc. Actual BitLife bottom nav: "Character", "Activities", "Assets", "Relationships", "Career"? I recall BitLife has bottom menu icons: Character, Relationships, Activities, Assets, Career. Top bar: age top center? Let me recall.

BitLife UI: At top, a thin bar showing age and name? Main screen has a large avatar, name, age, "Happy" meter maybe. There are action rows: "Age +", "Activities", "Relationships", "Career", "Assets". Older BitLife: bottom navigation with 5 icons: Character, Relationships, Activities, Assets, Career. Header with money and age.

Need a robust game loop:
- New life, random name, gender, country.
- Aging with random events/dialogs.
- Activities: gym, library, meditate, party, doctor, walk, play games, etc.
- Relationships: parents, siblings, friends, partners, children; interactions.
- Education: elementary, middle, high school, university, graduate.
- Career: jobs, promotions, salaries, interviews.
- Assets: house, car, properties.
- Finances.
- Death, legacy.
- Save/load localStorage.
- Mobile-only: viewport meta, no body scroll, touch-friendly. Desktop maybe show phone frame? User says specifically mobile players, no web scrolling. We'll make it responsive full-screen mobile; on desktop, center a phone-sized app.

Given time, need build a polished, deep game. We have lots of token budget. Use vanilla JS or React? Empty repo, simplest static index.html + CSS + JS modules. Start script serves static. We can use no build step. Need maybe icons via inline SVG. Fonts: BitLife uses rounded sans (maybe "Nunito" / "Baloo"?). We can load Google fonts? Network may not be available in preview; better use system fonts with fallbacks. Could bundle via npm? No. Use CSS font stack, maybe include a local SVG-based logo.

Need screenshot checks. We have playwright-cli preinstalled. We can run server via start.sh, capture with playwright. But instructions mention use playwright-cli. Let me check availability. Also need mobile viewport screenshot ≤1280 wide, small JPEG.

First, plan the app architecture.

App concept: "Life Happens" life simulator. Main views:
1. Splash/Home screen: logo, "New Life", "Continue", "Lives" maybe. BitLife's start screen has "Life Happens" logo with character and buttons. Since name change.
2. Character creation modal/screen: randomize, gender, country, name, appearance options, start life.
3. Game main screen:
   - Header: age badge? Name and money.
   - Character card: big avatar (CSS-built), name, age, "alive" status, stats bars.
   - Main feed/timeline of recent events.
   - Bottom nav tabs: Life (home), Activities, Relationships, Assets, Career/More.
   - Age button prominent: "Age +1" at bottom center? In BitLife you tap "+ Age" button near avatar. We'll implement a floating "Age" button.
4. Activities screen: grid/list of actions: Gym, Library, Doctor, Meditate, Party, Salon, Casino, Vacation, Crime, etc. With energy? BitLife actions are year-limited? Actually most activities can be done multiple times but age only via age button. We'll allow limited per year (3 actions) to add strategy? BitLife doesn't limit, but each action ages? In BitLife, activities are actions that can be done repeatedly? I think each action can be done once per year maybe not. We'll keep simple: actions have costs/effects, some limited once per year.
5. Relationships: list of family, friends, partners with relationship bars, interactions (spend time, gift, argue, propose, etc.).
6. Assets: money, properties, vehicles, items.
7. Career/Education: current job/school, job market, apply, promotion, quit. Education enrollment.
8. Events modal with choices (BitLife style popups), random life events on aging.
9. Death screen with summary, "Restart".

Data model:
person:
- id, firstName, lastName, gender, country, age, birthYear, alive, causeOfDeath
- stats: happiness, health, smarts, looks (0-100)
- money, salary, expenses
- education: level, GPA, degree, major
- job: title, company, salary, performance, years
- relationships: array {id, name, type, relation, age, alive, closeness, gender, partnerStatus}
- assets: {homes:[], cars:[], other:[]}
- activities done this year
- log: array of events
- flags/conditions: pregnant? spouse, children, criminalRecord, fame, etc.
- country determines currency and names.

Gameplay:
- Age up: increments age, applies health/happiness changes, salary income - expenses, relationship aging, random events (illness, school, promotions, love, death of relatives, lottery, etc.), milestone events (school enrollment choices at 5/6, high school, graduation at 18, college decisions, job offers, marriage, kids, retirement, death).
- Health declines after 50, risk increases. Death at old age based on health.
- Choices in event modals affect stats/money/relationships.

Need polished visuals:
BitLife look: light cream/off-white background (#f6f4ee?), teal/green accent (#00b894?), cards white with rounded corners, top app bar dark? Let me recall actual BitLife: I remember a white top bar with "BitLife" logo, green buttons, background light beige. Character avatar cartoon. The app uses a bottom tab bar with icons and labels. Event popups have dark blue headings? Let me search web for screenshots to get UI accurate. We have websearch/webfetch. Could search for BitLife UI screenshots descriptions. But we shouldn't copy assets; reference for layout. Use image search skill maybe. Let's search quickly.

Need maybe use image generation for avatar? Better to build avatars with CSS/SVG. BitLife avatars are simple cartoon heads. We can generate inline SVG avatars with skin/hair/eyes options. This gives custom look without assets.

I could use emoji for activity icons, but BitLife uses colored icons. Inline SVG icon set is better.

# Skill: image-search

# 图片搜索 Skill

你是一个专业的图片素材搜索助手，负责为内容创作查找合适的配图。

## 核心能力

1. **多维度过滤**：按尺寸、颜色、类型（照片/插画/GIF）筛选
2. **版权筛选**：支持按授权类型过滤图片
3. **自动下载**：可将图片下载到本地目录
4. **结构化输出**：返回图片元数据便于后续处理

## 使用方式

### 步骤 1：运行搜索脚本

```bash
python scripts/image_search.py "搜索关键词" --max_results 10 --size Large
```

**参数说明：**

- `query`：搜索关键词（必填）
- `--max_results`：返回的最大图片数（默认 10）
- `--size`：图片尺寸，可选 `Small`、`Medium`、`Large`、`Wallpaper`
- `--color`：颜色过滤，如 `Red`、`Blue`、`Green`、`Monochrome`
- `--type`：图片类型，可选 `photo`、`clipart`、`gif`、`transparent`、`line`
- `--layout`：布局，可选 `Square`、`Tall`、`Wide`
- `--license`：版权过滤，如 `any`、`Public`、`Share`、`Modify`
- `--region`：搜索区域（默认 `zh-cn`）
- `--download`：下载图片到指定目录
- `--output`：输出 JSON 文件路径

### 步骤 2：查看搜索结果

脚本会输出 JSON 格式的结果：

```json
{
  "query": "科技插图",
  "timestamp": "2026-01-21T10:30:00",
  "total_results": 10,
  "results": [
    {
      "title": "科技未来城市插图",
      "image": "https://example.com/image.jpg",
      "thumbnail": "https://example.com/thumb.jpg",
      "url": "https://example.com/page",
      "source": "example.com",
      "width": 1920,
      "height": 1080,
      "local_path": "./images/image_001.jpg"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 步骤 3：下载图片（可选）

使用 `--download` 参数自动下载图片到本地：

```bash
python scripts/image_search.py "风景摄影" --download ./images --max_results 5
```

下载的图片会按顺序命名：`image_001.jpg`、`image_002.png` 等。

## 搜索策略

### 关键词优化

对于内容配图，建议使用描述性关键词：

- ❌ "AI" → 结果太泛
- ✅ "AI 机器人 未来科技 插图" → 更精准

### 尺寸选择建议

| 用途        | 推荐尺寸          |
| ----------- | ----------------- |
| 文章头图    | Large / Wallpaper |
| 正文配图    | Medium / Large    |
| 缩略图      | Small / Medium    |
| 横幅 Banner | Wide + Large      |

### 颜色搭配

根据文章主题选择配色：

- 科技类：Blue、Monochrome
- 自然类：Green
- 警示类：Red、Orange
- 简约风：Monochrome

## 与图片处理 Skill 配合

搜索到图片后，可以使用 [图片处理 Skill](../image-processing/SKILL.md) 进行：

- 添加文字标注
- 插入配文（底部边框/内部贴纸）
- 调整尺寸

## 注意事项

1. **网络要求**：需要能够访问 DuckDuckGo 图片搜索服务
2. **版权合规**：下载图片前请确认版权许可，商业用途需特别注意
3. **下载限流**：自动下载会有适当延迟，避免触发限制
4. **图片有效性**：部分图片 URL 可能失效，脚本会自动跳过并报告

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile-first life simulation renamed “Life Happens,” with a polished BitLife-inspired interface and core life, career, relationship, school, asset, event, and save systems.

## Requirements
- Mobile players only, with no web-style page scrolling or desktop-oriented layout.
- Use the name “Life Happens.”
- Recreate an exact replica of BitLife, including all UI, content, and mechanics.
- Provide a complete playable game now.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a mobile portrait PWA rather than a direct desktop web game.
- Used a BitLife-like visual system and layout, with original branding and the name “Life Happens.”
- Split game logic across country, job, asset, activity, event, lifecycle, action, avatar, and engine modules.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the mobile application shell and PWA metadata.
- Added extensive life-simulation data for countries, careers, education, assets, activities, relationships, random events, and achievements.
- Implemented save/load, profile creation, new-person generation, avatar generation, currency formatting, life aging, lifecycle, and action systems.
- Added app branding, icon, manifest, local fonts, styles, and a mobile navigation structure.
- Created the initial HTML entry point and modular JavaScript architecture.

### Active
- The game implementation is being assembled across the existing modular files.
- UI and gameplay integration still need final verification.

### Blocked
- No explicit technical blocker is recorded.
- Exact feature parity with BitLife is not verifiable from the available work summary.

## Next Move
1. Open and validate `js/app.js`, `styles.css`, `css/base.css`, and `index.html` for complete UI integration.
2. Exercise profile creation, aging, feed events, relationships, careers, assets, death, and save/load in a mobile viewport.
3. Fix any runtime or rendering issues found during browser testing.
4. Capture final mobile screenshots and inspect the latest images.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/index.html`: Main application document.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/app.js`: Primary UI and application controller.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/engine.js`: Save state, profile creation, relationships, money, and persistence.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/lifecycle.js`: Aging, education, death, achievements, and life progression.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/actions.js`: Public exports for gameplay actions.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/actions-life.js`: Jobs, education, relationships, assets, banking, and life actions.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/actions-events.js`: Activity and random-event resolution.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/events.js`: Random event definitions.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/events-more.js`: Additional random event definitions.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/jobs.js`: Jobs and career requirements.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/countries.js`: Countries, cities, names, currencies, and majors.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/js/avatar.js`: SVG avatar generation and appearance options.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/styles.css`: Primary consolidated styling.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/css/base.css`: Base responsive and component styling.
- `/home/runner/work/Life-Happens/Life-Happens/manifest.webmanifest`: PWA configuration.

## Important Context
- The application is intended to run in portrait, standalone mobile mode.
- Existing work was saved to the repository but no final browser-verification result was reported.
- The requested “exact replica” scope was implemented as a BitLife-style life simulator with original branding rather than verified exact parity to the real game.

## Objective
- Complete and verify the mobile-first “Life Happens” life simulator, including gameplay flows and responsive UI.

## Requirements
- Portrait-oriented mobile experience without web-style page scrolling.
- Use the name “Life Happens” and deliver a playable game.
- The user requested an exact BitLife replica; implementation uses original branding and a BitLife-inspired style.

## Decisions
- Keep the modular JavaScript architecture and mobile PWA approach.
- Treat browser verification as part of completion; inspect screenshots and gameplay flows.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the UI controller in `js/app.js` and app styling in `styles.css`; added the age dock and corrected font URLs.
- Fixed effect application and profile migration defaults in `js/engine.js`.
- Fixed education initialization and age-transition handling in `js/lifecycle.js`.
- Adjusted mobile layout spacing so stats, age dock, and navigation fit without page overflow.
- Verified creation, aging, university enrollment/graduation, job application/actions, banking, relationship interactions, save/reload/resume, death/rebirth, settings, life review, and archived lives in mobile Playwright runs; no browser console/page errors were reported.
- Verified at 360×640 that the stats card, age dock, and bottom nav fit the viewport, with no horizontal or document-level vertical overflow.

### Active
- Re-run the full age-to-18 and graduation flow after the latest education progression change; the broad full test preceded that final adjustment.
- Consider additional gameplay validation for activity and event choices, including edge cases.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run syntax checks on all `js/*.js` modules.
2. Re-run the Playwright age progression through high school, age 18, university, and graduation after the latest `js/lifecycle.js` change.
3. Review any resulting failures and report verification status.

## Relevant Files
- `js/app.js`: UI controller and gameplay interactions.
- `js/engine.js`: Profile creation, migrations, save/load, and game state.
- `js/lifecycle.js`: Aging, education progression, and death.
- `js/actions-life.js`, `js/actions-events.js`: Player actions and event outcomes.
- `styles.css`, `css/base.css`: App and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/full-test.mjs`: Broad gameplay verification script.
- `/tmp/opencode/edge-test.mjs`: Small-screen, settings, review, and archive checks.
- `/tmp/opencode/30-age18.png`, `/tmp/opencode/31-graduated.png`: Screenshots from the broad test.

## Important Context
- The browser app is served at `http://localhost:8123/`.
- Changes have not been confirmed committed; the earlier status showed numerous untracked project files.

if (p.age >= 85) risk += (p.age - 85) * 0.02;
if (p.age >= 18) risk += Math.max(0, 50 - p.stats.health) * 0.0015;
